lineage: Independent official SAM3.1 per-frame geometric-box candidate route through an explicit separately versioned adapter; no P2, v9, SAM2, corridor, geometry-fill, or historical-mask pixel inheritance.

human_prompt.box_formula: For each authoritative ego side, take the axis-aligned bounds of all 21 projected hand joints plus the closest image-boundary point to the wrist, pad by 1.25 times projected wrist width, and clamp only the prompt coordinates to the image.
human_prompt.wrist_width_definition: Euclidean distance between projected joints 5 and 17.
human_prompt.pixel_effect: The box is passed to the official SAM3.1 add_prompt API. The box, its corridor, and its raster are never unioned with or used to crop output pixels.

object_prompt.selection: Object6D analytic cylinder may only select the returned current/propagated SAM object instance.

output.name: candidate_human_mask
output.positive_semantics: Pixels in whole current-frame SAM3.1 box-prompt instances that support exactly one authoritative ego side at hand, wrist, and image boundary.
output.negative_semantics: All other pixels, including rejected background-person instances and the selected visible task-object SAM instance.

pixel_algebra: candidate_human_mask = union(accepted whole current-frame official SAM3.1 positive-box instances) AND NOT(selected current-frame or propagated SAM3.1 object instance)
forbidden_pixel_sources: box raster or box hard crop
raw_instance_evidence: Every SAM3.1 box-prompt instance bitmap, score, ID, side support, prompt box, and selection decision must be serialized before union.
fail_closed: Invalid or excessive prompt boxes, official signature drift, missing side-specific hand/wrist/boundary support, ambiguous two-side support, missing Object6D-selected visible object, temporal regression, or pixel-lineage failure yields HOLD with no fallback.
